description: This file defines the 'OperationalCountry' entity class for the OrangeHRM system using Doctrine ORM. It maps to the 'ohrm_operational_country' database table and includes properties for 'id' and 'country', along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OperationalCountry
classes.description: An entity representing an operational country in the OrangeHRM system, linked to a country entity and stored in the 'ohrm_operational_country' table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the operational country.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the operational country.
